title: Japanese–Indonesian Maternal and Child Health Terminology Glossary: A Bidirectional Reference for the Selayar Project
description:
This bilingual glossary provides Japanese–Indonesian and Indonesian–Japanese terminology relevant to maternal and child health, perinatal care, obstetric emergencies, referral systems, telemedicine, and healthcare financing. Developed in connection with field research in the Selayar Islands, South Sulawesi, Indonesia, it is designed to support interpreters, healthcare professionals, trainees, and international health cooperation activities.

The resource includes explanatory notes on selected Japanese healthcare and health insurance concepts. Both language directions (479 entries each) are provided in a single booklet, as an editable Word document and a print-ready PDF edition (A5 booklet format; duplex booklet printing recommended).

The glossary was compiled with the assistance of artificial intelligence from project documents, training materials, and 2026 field research records. It is an educational reference resource and does not replace official clinical guidelines or professional medical interpretation. Translations should be verified for the context of use.
